description: Aircraft Commander is pilot in command of the tasked C-17 sortie.
Loadmaster rigs and releases Container Delivery System (CDS) bundles via the airdrop release mechanism.
Aircraft Commander communicates with Air Traffic Control and ground drop-zone personnel via the tactical communications system.

description: Loadmaster coordinates drop timing and drop-zone readiness with the Drop Zone Support Team Leader before releasing CDS bundles.

description: Drop Zone Support Team Leader relays drop-zone status and wind data to the flight deck (Aircraft Commander) via the tactical communications system — the actual first hop of the information path that ultimately reaches the Loadmaster relayed through the flight deck.

Aircraft Commander relays drop-zone status/wind updates during the run-in and gives the verbal release command ("Mark") to the Loadmaster via intercom — the trigger for the Loadmaster's release-execution decision.

doctrineSource.publication: C-17 Pilot (c17pilot.com), "C-17 Airdrop Operations — How Cargo and Troops Exit at 25,000 Feet"

description: Loadmaster confirms release completion ("Cargo away") to the flight deck via intercom immediately after executing the release.
